the source expressly identifies the beneficial interest rather than registered title alone

contradiction_rules: A later CS01 quantity that matches an earlier SH01 quantity does not resolve whether the holding arose by allotment, transfer, nominee arrangement, or another movement.
A date entered as a member does not resolve the transaction mechanism unless the register or linked instrument says so.
An entity named in a public funding announcement may be an investor at round level without being the legal subscriber or registered allottee on a particular issue.
An eligible member named in written resolutions is not thereby a recipient of a later allotment.
A qualifying registered holding under the articles does not prove that any governance right was exercised.
prohibited_inferences: date of membership proves date or mechanism of allotment
round participation proves legal subscriber vehicle
major investor status proves exercise of a class or governance right
refusal or silence proves concealment, wrongdoing, or absence of records
a procedural court application proves any fact about the allotments
control_question: Does the obtained source expressly name the person or vehicle as allottee for a uniquely identified September 2025 issue, or does it establish only resulting registered title or another register movement?
